details.description: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct is Qwen's compact agentic coding model, a mixture-of-experts model with 30.5 billion total parameters and 3.3 billion activated per token (128 experts, 8 active), released July 31, 2025. It targets code generation, debugging, and agentic coding tasks such as repository-scale understanding and tool calling, with a native 262,144-token context window (extendable to 1 million tokens via Yarn) and integrations for Qwen Code and Cline. Qwen's model card states it runs in non-thinking mode only.
advantages: Built for agentic coding tasks with repository-scale code understanding, per Qwen's model card.
Native 262,144-token context window, extendable to 1 million tokens using Yarn (Qwen's model card).
Supports agentic browser-use tasks alongside coding, per Qwen's model card.
Integrates with Qwen Code and Cline for IDE-based agentic coding workflows.
Uses only 3.3B active parameters per token (30.5B total), a smaller compute footprint than the 480B-A35B sibling model for similar agentic coding tasks.
Fireworks AI states the full 262,144-token context window is usable on its on-demand deployments.
disadvantages: Non-thinking mode only; does not generate <think></think> reasoning blocks (Qwen's model card).
use_cases: Code generation and debugging for software projects
Agentic coding tasks such as multi-step feature implementation
Repository-scale code understanding across large codebases
Tool-calling and function-calling for coding agents
